headline: Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements, statutory tax exemptions, and two ATB settlements.
summary: The board approved minutes from two earlier meetings, approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for two weeks, and approved one motor vehicle excise abatement for denial. It also approved statutory exemption applications across several clauses, denied two Clause 41C applications by signatures, and approved two ATB settlements by signatures.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the July 07, 2026 and July 10, 2026 meetings.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatements for the week of June 29 to July 03 by signatures.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatements for the week of July 06 to July 10 by signatures.
Approved 1 motor vehicle excise abatement for denial.
Approved statutory exemption applications for Clause 17E (19 applications), Clause 22 (78), Clause 22A (1), Clause 22C (2), Clause 22D (13), Clause 22E (53), Clause 37A (6), and Clause 41C (24).

decision_evidence.quote: R. Rondeau made a motion to approve the minutes, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.

A. Lombardo made a motion to approve these applications, R. Rondeau 2nd – Unanimous.
2 Clause 41C applications were denied by signatures
2 ATB settlements were approved by signatures
